Description.DefaultText: Hidden marker, written every 5 seconds by AcademyGuestPatch: which resident is at the Academy with the player. 0 = nobody (or the player is not in the Academy), 1 = the Miller, 2 = the Weaver, 3 = the Apothecary, 4 = the Professor. When several are there, the first of that list wins. The Sit In buttons on the Lecture Hall read it. Clamped to 0..4.
